jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A very wide landscape editorial cover 2.5:1 for an essay about AI coding accelerating generation while software review remains a bottleneck. Stunning conceptual studio photograph of a single unusual transparent industrial funnel lying slightly diagonally in a clean warm ivory studio. An enormous clear bulbous chamber crowded with many cobalt-blue small rectangular code tiles, feeding through a very narrow amber constriction with a few tiles visibly queued; only two tiles emerge on the other side into a clean shallow output tray. Visible material contrast of transparent glass and brushed metal, almost tangible shadows, elegant ink-navy accents, crisp side view, dramatic but restrained light. One immediately legible visual paradox: abundant input, restricted output. Plenty of clean negative space. No people, no robots, no unrelated objects, no text, no numbers, no letters. Keep entire funnel and tray within central 80 percent for safe cropping into 2.35:1 and 5:2. Sophisticated, clear, surprising, not cluttered.
